title: Level 8 - "Cave Systems"
survival_class: SURVIVAL DIFFICULTY CLASS 4; Exit: 4/5 Very Difficult to Exit; Environment: 4/5 Extreme Environmental Risk; Entities: 4/5 Extreme Hostile Presence
physical_identity: Sprawling subterranean network of organic karst caves, cold and dark, with almond water pools and rivers, stalagspikes, non-Euclidean connectivity and shifting gravity. M.E.G. marked 9th Road crosses islands of stability.
scale_topology: Very large underground network (Handyland alone spans acres); loops and non-linear connections; vertical shafts; fully enclosed.
anomalies: Stalagspikes shaped like hands or objects
lighting_sound: Dark; lamps shine dimmer and sounds echo louder than expected; chittering; bioluminescent fungi, red moss, light guides, faint aurora in Handyland.

entities.name: Wranglers
entities.behavior: Giant serpentine predators that burrow or noclip through rock

entities.name: Hands of tar
entities.behavior: Drag victims into hot tar pools

entities.name: Deathmoths
entities.behavior: Territorial females at New Movile Cave

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: wranglers, arachnids, hands of tar, light guides, death rats, deathmoths, scits, dunks, curabitur birds, nguithr'xhurs, smilers, camo crawlers, wretches; some areas empty
items_communities: Battery heater and flashlight in vignette

entrances.quote: The Road starts at the entrance pool from Level 6
Walking through a specific dark hallway in Level 103 will lead to Level 8.
Jumping into the well in Level 135 can lead to Level 8.
Small tunnels in Level 4.1 most often lead to Level 8.
The entrance, however, will vanish as soon as one passes through

exits.quote: runs all the way to the exit at Level 9
Vents in the ceiling of the Rottnest Jungle are reported to lead to Level 2
dragged into either Level 41 or Level 91 upon waking
Rare, tight passageways coated in its characteristic silvery substance
No-clipping through certain cave walls has been reported to lead to Level 93
Entering is ill-advised, since Level 203 has no exit.
Purposely no-clipping through the ceiling has been reported
Falling through the floor has been reported

signature_mechanic: Non-Euclidean caves with per-cavern gravity shifts, flash flooding and accelerated entropy, navigated by M.E.G. road markers that decay unless maintained.
verticality: Vertical shafts to climb, floating rocks, gravity-tilted caverns; ceiling nests in Rottnest Jungle.
do_not: Make almond water harmful to drink
conflicts_notes: Wikidot CSS noise at top. Entrance list text mixes slug-less levels. Level 6 and 9 are named in text; Level 7 and 480 appear only in link list.

key_quotes.quote: Turning back may not return one to where they came from before.
Entropic effects also intensify when an area is left unobserved.
Bone-dry chambers may be completely submerged in a matter of seconds.
The Road starts at the entrance pool from Level 6
Some portions of Level 8 appear empty, devoid of entities altogether.
Jumping into the well in Level 135 can lead to Level 8.
Entering is ill-advised, since Level 203 has no exit.
